_readme: Copy this file to add a project. Name it <section>-<order>-<id>.json, e.g. proj-050-quantstorm.json.
Files starting with _ are ignored by the build. Delete this _readme key in your copy.
Then run: python scripts/build.py   (or python scripts/publish.py to build, check, and push)
section  projects = Quantitative Research (numbered 01, 02...)
frontier = Research (numbered R1, R2...)
engineering = Engineering (numbered E1, E2...)
order    sort key within the section. Use gaps of 10 so you can insert later without renumbering.
Card numbers are derived from position, never written by hand.
id       becomes id="proj-<id>". Must be unique across all files.
badge    kind is one of live, progress, research, published, freelance, intern. Text is free-form.
Omit the whole badge key for no badge.
String values are emitted as HTML, so x, x and & all work.
BLOCK TYPES (blocks array, rendered top to bottom):
text     paras: [...]                      prose paragraphs
bullets  items: [...]                      the standard dotted list
arch     flow: [...] or flows: [[...],...]  architecture diagram, note is optional
flow entries: "Label|small text", "*Label|small" for a highlighted box,
"->" for an arrow, "+" for parallel inputs merging
table    cols, rows, caption, note          results table; prefix a row's first cell with *
to highlight it; append |pos |neg |flat |amber to any cell to colour it
nulls    label, items, after               red-ruled callout for negative results.
items and after are both optional, but you need at least one.
html     raw: "..."                        escape hatch for anything the schema misses
SIDEBAR TYPES:
tags     items: [...]                      chip list
metrics  items: [[label, value, tone?]]    tone is pos, neg, flat or amber
links    items: [[text, url]]              opens in a new tab
name: Project Name
tagline: One or two sentences: what it is, and why it is worth a reader's time.

blocks.note:
One idea per line.
Each line renders as its own sentence in the note block.

blocks.label: Negative results, published rather than buried
items: The thing that failed, and the number that says so
One decision per bullet, with the reason it was made
